title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 38
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 38: the word against Gog of the land of Magog, who comes up against a land of unwalled villages.

questions.text: Toward whom is the son of man told to set his face in this chapter?
questions.explanation: The son of man is told to set his face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, and to prophesy against him.

answers.text: Gog, of the land of Magog

questions.text: Of which three is Gog called the prince?
questions.explanation: The Lord Yahweh says he is against Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will put into Gog's jaws?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will turn Gog around and put hooks into his jaws, and bring him out with all his army.

questions.text: Which three peoples are named as being with them, all with shield and helmet?
questions.explanation: Persia, Cush, and Put are with them, all of them with shield and helmet.

questions.text: Where is the house of Togarmah said to be?
questions.explanation: Gomer and all his hordes are named, and the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, with all his hordes.

answers.text: On the islands of the sea
In the middle of the earth
In the uttermost parts of the north

questions.text: What kind of land does Gog plan to go up to?
questions.explanation: Gog says he will go up to the land of unwalled villages, to those who dwell securely without walls and having neither bars nor gates.

answers.text: A land of many great rivers

questions.text: Who will ask Gog, "Have you come to take the plunder?"
questions.explanation: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish with all the young lions of it will ask him whether he has come to take the plunder.

answers.text: Persia, Cush, and Put with their horsemen
The priests and elders of the sanctuary
Sheba, Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish
The prophets of Israel of old time

questions.text: What does Yahweh say will surely happen in the land of Israel in that day?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that in his jealousy and the fire of his wrath there will surely be a great shaking in the land of Israel in that day.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say will happen when he calls for a sword against Gog?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will call for a sword against Gog to all his own mountains, and every man's sword will be against his brother.

answers.text: Every man's sword will be against his brother
They will all flee to the sea
They will make a treaty with Israel
They will lay down their weapons

questions.text: What will Yahweh rain on Gog, his hordes and the peoples with him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will rain on them an overflowing shower, with great hailstones, fire, and sulfur.

answers.text: Ashes and clouds of fine dust
